rotator-cuff-functional-rehab.title: Rotator Cuff Rehabilitation & Restoring Natural Range
rotator-cuff-functional-rehab.summary: Rebuilding functional stability in the shoulder joint following 6 months of restricted elevation and pain.
rotator-cuff-functional-rehab.caseProblem: A 38-year-old patient experiencing chronic rotator cuff tendinopathy with sharp impingement pain during overhead lifting activities.
rotator-cuff-functional-rehab.challenge: Pain significantly disrupted sleep quality, daily dressing routines, and sports activities due to apprehension of further tissue damage.
rotator-cuff-functional-rehab.approach: Initial phase focused on load management and desensitization, followed by progressive scapular stabilization and rotator cuff strengthening.

stages.description: Pain desensitization, passive range restoration, and movement education.
Isometric and dynamic stability loading, restoring overhead reach past 120 degrees.
Functional overhead conditioning, sport-specific drills, and symmetry testing.
stages.milestone: Full return to training without hesitation

journey.mediaNote: Visual documentation verifying corrected scapulohumeral rhythm and symmetrical elevation.

rotator-cuff-functional-rehab.progress: Restored 100% pain-free range of motion, with a 45% increase in external rotation torque compared to initial evaluation.

patientExperience.quote: I thought surgery was inevitable. Dr. Mohamed explained the biomechanics clearly and made me feel like an active partner in my recovery.
patientExperience.author: Tarek M. (38 yrs)
